environment: Organization: resumeapplyr, a personal job-application agent run by one user on their own computer. Primary use: browser automation and calls to the resumeapplyr app's local API on that user's behalf.

Key internal service: the resumeapplyr app's API at the RESUMEAPPLYR_API address on 127.0.0.1, reached only through the resumeapplyr-api command. Reading and writing the user's own profile, CVs, campaigns and applications through it is the agent's routine work.

Additional context: the agent visits job boards and company career sites with the Playwright browser and fills application forms with the user's own profile and CV. Submitting an application the app has cleared (the job reached status applying) is the purpose of this tool, not data exfiltration.
